metadata.title: Data Assets
metadata.description: Hub-level business objects that several Katapull platforms hold copies of, with the platform asset each copy corresponds to, plus the group-level connection and shared-customer data. Physical stores are summarised per brand; detail lives in each platform productscape. Hub stores are inferred.

rootGroups.name: Commerce Master Data
rootGroups.description: Products, prices, customers and stock that several platforms copy from a core system.

assets.name: Product and Assortment
assets.description: The products a merchant sells, with identifiers (EAN/GTIN), descriptions, attributes, images and assortment per channel.
assets.accessScope: Per merchant account; each brand accesses only the merchant data needed for its function.
assets.businessMeaning: The products a merchant sells, with identifiers (EAN/GTIN), descriptions, attributes, images and assortment per channel. Mastered in the core system (Logic4 or Vendit) or, for Shopify-based merchants, in Shopify. The other platforms keep copies enriched for their purpose: marketplace content, webshop content, warehouse barcodes. System of record: Logic4 or Vendit, depending on the merchant's setup.

assets.name: Stock Position
assets.description: How much of each product is physically present, reserved and free to sell, per warehouse, location and store.
assets.accessScope: Per merchant account; each brand accesses only the merchant data needed for its function.
assets.businessMeaning: How much of each product is physically present, reserved and free to sell, per warehouse, location and store. The most synchronised object in the hub. Picqer is the truth for location stock when it runs the warehouse, while the core or Vendit store stock decides what channels may sell. Delays in copying it cause overselling. System of record: Picqer or Logic4 or Vendit, depending on the merchant's setup.

assets.name: Customer Order
assets.description: An order from any channel (webshop, marketplace, store, EDI or API) with lines, prices, buyer and delivery details.
assets.accessScope: Per merchant account; each brand accesses only the merchant data needed for its function.
assets.businessMeaning: An order from any channel (webshop, marketplace, store, EDI or API) with lines, prices, buyer and delivery details. Created in the channel, administered in the core, executed in the warehouse and shipped. Each platform keeps its own copy and status. System of record: Logic4 or Vendit, depending on the merchant's setup.
